name: MCAD demo objectives/scenarios pack for AdventureWorksDW and SteelWheels
description: V9.5.6 demo pack: additional objectives and Q1-Q6 scenarios for AdventureWorksDW and SteelWheels, usable as integrated defaults or load-on-demand demonstration material.
notes: Each scenario follows the same Q1-Q6 pattern: ALLOW Sales, ALLOW Quantity, BLOCK wrong territory, BLOCK wrong product, BLOCK bad grain, BLOCK redundant query.
SteelWheels XMLA scenarios use Descendants([Time].[Years].[YYYY], [Time].[Months]) to avoid putting the same Time hierarchy independently on ROWS and WHERE.
Use bi-stack/scripts/load_demo_objectives_scenarios.sh to import this pack into a running MCAD demo instance.
